## Purpose

C196 completes the accepted-store transition that C195 left untested: promote the qualified 365 mm repair G over accepted 375 mm revision H, reject an edit expecting the real former H revision before native work, and regenerate from the retained accepted source.

## Completed result

Reviewed candidate: `b5e8094f0af5557e8d52541884750a8febbc0e6f` (tree `6988167ed8a6ab5238569a9b4b4b0cb91dd6198e`). The committed acceptance record is true. Preparation passed 2,831 checks, independent result review passed 958 checks and archive review passed 3,654 checks. The original execution used two constructions, one static stale-revision rejection and two saved-scene replays, with no retry or new author. Each replay reproduced 481 samples; the continuous mapping bound is 0.07451646802035088 mm against 0.2 mm. Receiving and visual evidence is explicitly inherited from exact matching C195 G deliveries.

## Integration verification

A fresh independent review of this exact candidate passed the documentation/preservation checker and recorded-only audit of all 911 archived files. All 13,789 preexisting files except README.md, STATUS.md and docs/README.md retain their Git blobs and modes; 47 new files are confined to the C196 engineering directory. Historical runtime, tests, contracts, tools, workflows and 1,691 prior evidence files are unchanged. No completed native trial was repeated.

Integration owner `c197-integration-7f9a31` acquired the bounded lease by expected-head nonforce update at `33ece59660d1c7fa82669e687708cc733f03494a`. Resulting-main verification and the merge receipt will be published separately. C197 begins only after that verification.

## Limits

The inherited legacy driver and supplemental tail remain FAILED: 4,239 distinct passing methods and thirteen torque-read methods NOT RUN after the unchanged 30,000 ms setup failure. This is a bounded development workflow result, not full regression, a complete release, concurrent-writer safety, general contact, live destination physics or comparative authoring advantage. No hosted execution was requested.
